shingled: Shingles are by far the most common roofing material, and are often the first thing that comes to mind when you picture a roof. They have a shorter lifespan than tile or metal roofs, but come at a lower price point, making them an excellent choice for many homeowners. They come in a wide variety of colors, many of which are designed specifically to keep your property cool throughout those hot LA summers.
metal: Metal roofs have come a long way in recent history. They offer more durability than shingle roofs, and with recent technology, can be engineered to emulate shingle or slate tile. They're even treated so that they're quiet in the rain! Of course, we're also able to install and repair classic standing seam metal. While metal does typically come at a higher price point, anyone looking to upgrade will be impressed with its durability and longevity.
flat: Many commerical and residential properties have flat roofs, which pose a unique challenge with regards to drainage. Casa Roofing Systems is well-versed in all sorts of flat roofing materials, including, but not limited to, silicone, TPO, PVC, and torch down. We'll make sure everything's sealed up so you can stay dry no matter how intense the rainy season may get.
tiled: Nothing quite compares to the sheer luxury and durability of a tile roof. While the underlayment and decking will have to be periodically replaced, many roofs use the same tiles for hundreds of years. We can install both traditional Spanish mission tiles and slate tiles, which more closely resemble shingles. Tile gives your property a unique, rustic look that can last a lifetime if properly cared for.
